title: Downloaded Windows Counted Toward Qualifying Nights on PAP Therapy Equipment in the Home
content:
# Downloaded Windows Counted Toward Qualifying Nights on PAP Therapy Equipment in the Home

**Records standard.** The nights of four hours or more counted toward the qualifying nights credited on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary are summed only over the windows downloaded from the units that count, and which windows are summed follows the units that have stood in the home:

1. on a record with a **malfunction swap**, only the windows downloaded from the serial now on the record are summed;
2. on a record with a **loaner delivery and no swap**, every window except those downloaded from the loaner's serial is summed;
3. on any other record, every window is summed.

**Where it is read.** Swaps and loaners are deliveries in the device's service history whose purpose is a malfunction swap or a loaner. Each downloaded 30-night compliance window carries the serial number of the unit it was downloaded from. The serial now on the record is the serial number on the PAP Therapy Equipment device record; the loaner's serial is the serial on the loaner delivery (the latest one, where there is more than one).

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical windows)

Windows on the record: 20 nights from serial A (the unit first set up), 18 nights from serial L (a loaner), 24 nights from serial B.

| Record shows | Serial now on the record | Windows summed | Nights |
|---|---|---|---|
| a malfunction swap from A to B | B | the B window | 24 |
| a loaner L, no swap | A | the A and B windows | 44 |
| neither | A | all three windows | 62 |

**Basis question.** *With both a swap and a loaner on the record, which line applies?* The swap line: only the windows downloaded from the serial now on the record are summed.
